design.form: One living red boxing glove with a white cuff panel, fine black trim and dark hollow wrist opening. No arm or body.
design.face: Half-lidded white eyes, dark pupils, raised red brow, small red nose and cocky closed-mouth smirk. Facial features have shape and depth in the glove material.
design.thumb: Red padded thumb/fold tucked behind the face like a swept-back tuft.
design.normalOrientation: Sideways hover, face readable upright; other poses may vary.
design.style: Detailed warm inked comic illustration, rich painted red shading.
design.cuff: Short red leather cuff, one inset white rectangular panel with a thin black rectangular keyline and visible red margins on all four sides; narrow black padded wrist rim and a dark hollow wrist opening. Keep the proportions from the character sheet in every pose. The white is a bordered panel, not an all-white wraparound sleeve. No lettering, laces or buckles.

scope: Applied to Book One and Book Three illustrations, matching appearance descriptions and shared character portraits. This latest pass updates Book Three only.
